$comment: From the P0/P1 prototype. Status: draft (prototype marks the checklist draft).

items.detail: Format, match length, substitutions and any local variations.

items.text: Check the pitch, goals and ball

items.detail: Share the Moving Up page or the 9v9 guide in your team group.

items.text: Decide how you will introduce offside
items.detail: Our offside guidance is still awaiting review.

items.text: Pick a starting shape and call it a starting picture
items.detail: For example the 1-3-1-3-1 in our 9v9 guide.

items.text: Plan how players share minutes and try different roles
items.detail: England Football best practice: at least half of each game.

items.text: Choose the few words you will use
items.detail: For example: Middle first. One goes, one stays.

items.text: Note one thing to work on after each game
items.detail: Write it down after the game, not during it.
